basic_info.description: 3390 Cesar Chavez Street is a 2,896 square foot vacant lot in the Mission District. This NCT Zoned lot provides excellent development potential with a 65' height limit in one of San Francisco's most vibrant locations. This amenity rich area provides walking access to many shops, restaurants, and conveniences. There is excellent public transportation options nearby, including the 24th Street BART station a few blocks away. Previously, plans were submitted to the city for six residential units above retail. Interested parties should investigate the development potential to their own satisfaction.
